label: PF Backlog 207
title: Backend: AG-UI event stream - typed run/tool/message events for the dashboard
body:
## Problem / why
The dashboard needs a typed, streaming view of a run; AG-UI standardizes agent<->frontend events.
## Goal
Emit an AG-UI-compatible event stream (RUN_*, STEP_*, TEXT_*, TOOL_CALL_*) from our run/event bus;
the dashboard consumes it (no coupling to internals).
## Acceptance criteria
- A client subscribes and receives run lifecycle + tool + message events for a run.
## Verification
- Drive a client against a live run; events arrive in order with lifecycle markers.
